axis_contract.endpoint_closure_rule: Only exact ordered source_kind -> target_kind pairs declared by a Relation Kind are permitted. Wildcards and inference from separate source/target lists are forbidden. Every new connection requires an explicit candidate pair, owner review, evidence, and validation before admission.
axis_contract.rule: A change on one axis does not imply a change on another axis unless an explicit typed coupling, schema rule, gate, validator, or owner decision declares that bridge.

claim_ceiling: This candidate compresses the previous 42 relation names into independently valued typed coupling axes, preserves their semantic distinctions as qualifier values, and closes use to explicitly declared ordered endpoint pairs. It does not admit Relation Kinds, permit undeclared endpoint connections, merge endpoints, grant authority, accept evidence, execute decisions, or establish runtime conformance.

entries.operational_effect: Records scoped membership or composition in member-to-container direction without transferring identity or authority.
entries.unique_question: Which governed container or scope is this member part of?

entries.operational_effect: Records intended contribution without proving success, realization, or value.

entries.operational_effect: Records evaluation scope without deciding evidence polarity, adoption, realization, or value.

entries.operational_effect: Records realization or execution without implying conformance, effectiveness, adoption, or evidence acceptance.

entries.operational_effect: Records whether an activity addresses or a Finding answers an Inquiry without converting either into the other.

entries.operational_effect: Records derivation, compilation, or projection while preserving source and derived identities.
